scope: One hypothetical harvest in the Philippines. GR2E/PSBRc82 composition; independent matched breeding-line yield comparisons. Not a national forecast.

yield.kind: illustrative baseline; not a measured treatment mean

milling.kind: approximate pilot milling recovery, assumed equal for both crops

dryMatter.kind: assumed 14% moisture; not a table measurement

concentration.kind: measured mean and sample range (not confidence interval)

storage.kind: illustrative sensitivity assumption; no storage duration inferred

cooking.kind: assumption in 2019 article, based on unpublished IRRI data

conversion.unit: micrograms beta-carotene per microgram vitamin A activity
conversion.kind: standard dietary RAE accounting; alternative from five healthy adults

portion.kind: illustrative portion; mixture in harvest mass proportions

reference.kind: U.S. RDA ages 1–3, comparison benchmark only

conventionalBeta.kind: modeled as zero; control measured below quantification, not proven absolute zero

excluded: measured fuel, tillage, irrigation, fertilizer, or pesticide-use change

matchedLand.interpretation: Land required to preserve the all-conventional rice-output baseline under the selected planting mix.

fieldworkIndex.interpretation: Area-scaled proxy for total field operations if tillage, fuel, irrigation, fertilizer, and crop-protection effort per hectare are unchanged.
fieldworkIndex.limitation: Not a measured input-use result and not evidence that each individual input changes in exact proportion to land area.
